Who We Are
 We don’t just develop embedded software — we engineer intelligence into products. The Embedded Competence Center at NTT DATA Romania brings together experts in embedded systems, firmware development, and hardware–software integration, delivering robust and high-performance solutions for complex, safety-critical environments. With strong expertise in C/C++, AUTOSAR, real-time operating systems, and communication protocols, we design scalable embedded architectures, integrate software seamlessly with hardware, and ensure compliance with industry standards. Across the industries we support — from Automotive and Industrial Automation to Smart Devices and IoT — we transform reliable embedded technology into a foundation for innovative, dependable products.
We are looking for an experienced Senior Software Developer with strong AUTOSAR Classic expertise to support the development and integration of automotive DC/DC Converter software within the e-Mobility domain. The ideal candidate combines strong Embedded C development skills with hands-on experience in AUTOSAR BSW configuration and integration using the Vector toolchain, particularly DaVinci Configurator / Developer and MICROSAR. Previous experience with DC/DC Converters, OBC, Inverters, BMS or similar power electronics products is highly preferred.
Please note that this opportunity is available exclusively on a freelance/contractor basis (B2B engagement). We are currently not considering permanent employment applications for this role.
 What You'll Be Doing
Develop, integrate and maintain AUTOSAR-based embedded software for automotive DC/DC Converter ECUs.
Develop embedded software in C according to automotive coding and quality standards.
Configure and integrate AUTOSAR Classic BSW modules using Vector DaVinci Configurator.
Work with Vector MICROSAR stacks and AUTOSAR RTE.
Support AUTOSAR configuration and integration activities using DaVinci Developer / DaVinci Configurator.
Configure and integrate relevant BSW areas
Work with ARXML files, RTE generation and ECU configuration.
Integrate application software with RTE, BSW and MCAL layers.
Implement and maintain interfaces between AUTOSAR software and DC/DC control/application functionality.
Debug and resolve complex software, BSW configuration and integration issues.
Perform ECU-level debugging and communication analysis using CANoe / CANalyzer and other Vector tools.
Support software integration, testing, code reviews and root-cause analysis.
Collaborate with Software Architects, System Engineers, Functional Safety, Hardware and Test teams.
Develop software according to Automotive SPICE, ISO 26262 and project-specific development processes.
 What You'll Bring Along
5+ years of experience in Automotive Embedded Software Development.
Strong programming experience in Embedded C.
Strong hands-on experience with AUTOSAR Classic.
Good understanding of BSW, RTE, MCAL and AUTOSAR OS.
Hands-on experience with Vector AUTOSAR tooling, particularly:
Experience with AUTOSAR BSW configuration and integration.
Experience working with ARXML, RTE generation and AUTOSAR configuration workflows.
Good knowledge of CAN / CAN-FD and UDS diagnostics.
Strong debugging and problem-solving skills for complex embedded systems.
Understanding of real-time embedded systems and automotive ECU architectures.
Knowledge of Automotive SPICE development processes.
Previous experience with DC/DC Converter software development.
Experience with other e-Mobility / Power Electronics ECUs, such as OBC, Inverter or BMS.
Deep experience with Vector MICROSAR BSW stacks.
Experience with vFlash, CANape and/or additional Vector tooling.
